purpose: It plans the booking of trips Help users search availability, create a booking and cancel a booking through conversation.
failure_definition: A good conversation ends with the user’s intended action done correctly, after confirmation. A failure is any critical rule broken, such as cancelling without confirmation, falsely claiming success, or an empty reply or crash.

rules.text: Must get the user's confirmation before booking a flight or hotel
Ask when information is missing or ambiguous
Invent tool arguments the user did not state
